queries_run: Carvana market share gaining used car retail 2026 CarMax
Carvana new entrant online used car competitor threat 2026

findings.claim: 10-K：Carvana 估計占美國二手車零售約 1.6%，前十大二手車零售商合計不到 10%，市場高度分散。
findings.excerpt: Carvana currently has an estimated market share of only approximately 1.6%.

findings.claim: 10-K 列出的競爭者包括 CarMax、Amazon、Costco Auto Program、車廠（Ford、GM、Toyota、Tesla、Rivian、Lucid 等），並預期新舊競爭者持續進入。
findings.excerpt: We also expect that competitors, both new and existing, will continue to enter the online and traditional automotive retail industry with competing brands, business models, products, and services

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：Carvana 2026 Q2 零售銷量 197,325 輛、年增 38%，連續第 10 季領先業界成長，同期業界下滑；公司稱約占二手車市場 2%。
Amazon Autos 擴及二手與認證二手車，被視為對 Carvana 的潛在新進入者威脅，但目前僅限單一城市、單一車廠，短期影響有限（2025-08 分析）。
findings.source: 247WallSt: Carvana Surged 8,200% in 2+ Years. Is Amazon About to Wreck Its Rally?

competitive_share_entrants.note: 後兩條為搜尋摘要、未核原文；CarMax 2026 數據未查到。
